title: rDPS Meter
changeNote: 0.1.17 - a fix for damage that was showing up under no name at all. A Defect orb's passive was credited to the orb only when it was evoked, or when a card triggered it; the passive that fires at the end of every turn - which is most of what Glass and Lightning ever deal - was landing unattributed. It now reads as the orb wherever it comes from. Block from an orb was never affected. Checked against game v0.109.1.
